verdict.rationale: The platform has background, event-driven mechanisms: transaction data refreshes daily on its own, and webhooks/OBWMS let you subscribe to real-time event notifications (including transaction notifications) instead of polling. However, any autonomous automation logic has to be built and hosted by the developer; the product only supplies data refreshes and event triggers. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or scheduled jobs, agent-driven autonomous workflows, and documentation or hands-on evidence of setting up background automations end to end.
